android.desc:
Shorten long and unnecessarily large links and URLs with this extremely useful tool! Why bother yourself with copying and pasting a long and ugly link? With Mini you can make your URL shorter, smaller and more attractive. Then, you can copy your shorter URL so you can use wherever you want. Or you could share directly to anyone by Facebook, Twitter (X), Whatsapp, email, Instagram or anywhere you want. What is even better: Mini is completely free to use, with no limits and no registration required! Go tiny and mini!

The Mini app offers you:
-Custom URL shortener and link shortener.
-Shorten any URL or link, making it as tiny as possible.
-Share with just one click on Facebook, Twitter (X), Whatsapp, email, Instagram or anywhere you want.
-Paste from the clipboard and copy the result, no need to type anything if you don't want to!
-Completely free, no accounts or registration required.
-No daily limits, use it as many times you want.
-Translated in english, portuguese, spanish, chinese, japanese and russian.
-Internet is required.
